enriched.title: Presente Contínuo e Vocabulário Cotidiano
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do presente contínuo para descrever situações atuais e enfatiza vocabulário relacionado ao cotidiano. Inclui prática com frases negativas e expressões comuns, além de foco em pronúncia e gramática.

vocabulary.definition: Used to express a reason or cause for something.
examples: I was late because of this traffic jam.
There is a man waiting outside.
I work on weekdays and rest on weekends.

vocabulary.definition: Despite something that was just said.
examples: I was tired, but even so, I went to the party.
She has a daily routine of jogging.

vocabulary.definition: The quality of being new, original, or unusual.
examples: The novelty of the idea attracted investors.

vocabulary.definition: Covered or saturated with water or another liquid.
examples: My shoes are wet because of the rain.

vocabulary.definition: The ability to assess and initiate things independently.
examples: She showed great initiative in solving the problem.

vocabulary.definition: A feeling of uncertainty or lack of conviction.
examples: There is no doubt that she is qualified for the job.

vocabulary.definition: A planned public or social occasion.
examples: The event will take place next Friday.

vocabulary.definition: The part of a plant that attaches it to the ground.
examples: The roots of the tree are deep in the soil.

grammar.explanation: The present continuous tense is used to describe actions happening right now or ongoing situations.
rules: Formed with the verb 'to be' + base verb + -ing.
Used for actions happening at the moment of speaking or temporary actions.
examples: I’m studying. The baby is sleeping.
commonMistakes: Using the wrong form of 'to be' (e.g., 'I studying' instead of 'I am studying').
Forgetting to add -ing to the verb (e.g., 'I am study' instead of 'I am studying').

expressions.usage: Used to describe events happening without interruption.
examples: We won three games in a row.

practiceQuestions.question: Create a sentence in the present continuous to explain why you can't join a meeting.
practiceQuestions.answer: I can't join the meeting because I'm finishing a report.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The present continuous is used to describe an action currently in progress.

practiceQuestions.question: Correct this sentence: 'She is play piano now.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The verb 'play' should be in its -ing form to match the present continuous tense.

culturalNotes: In English-speaking countries, using 'daily' often refers to habits or routines, which is a common topic in conversations about health and productivity.
Expressions like 'even so' are frequently used in formal and informal discussions to contrast ideas.
studyTips: Practice forming sentences in the present continuous by describing your current actions.
Use flashcards to memorize the new vocabulary and their translations.
originalExamples: Don't ask me to sit next to Noah. I'm avoiding contact with him. (Não me peça para sentar ao lado do Noah. Estou evitando contato com ele.)
I can't participate in the project. I'm finishing another campaign. (Não posso participar do projeto. Estou terminando outra campanha.)
Please don't make so much noise. I’m studying. The baby is sleeping. (Por favor, não faça tanto barulho. Estou estudando. O bebê está dormindo.)
I need to eat something soon. I’m eating every three hours. I’m getting hungry. (Eu preciso comer algo logo. Estou comendo a cada três horas. Estou ficando com fome.)
I don't have anywhere to live now. I’m travelling all the time / around the world. (Eu não tenho onde morar agora. Estou viajando o tempo todo / ao redor do mundo.)
We need to go to the supermarket. I’m cooking the last piece of meat. (Precisamos ir ao supermercado. Estou cozinhando o último pedaço de carne.)
They don't need their car any more. They’re living near to the subway. (Eles não precisam mais do carro. Eles estão morando perto do metrô.)
Things are not so good at work. I’m selling below the target. (As coisas não estão tão boas no trabalho. Estou vendendo abaixo da meta.)
It isn't true what he said. He’s lying about his work. (Não é verdade o que ele disse. Ele está mentindo sobre o trabalho dele.)
We're going to get wet if we go out now. It’s raining now. (Nós vamos nos molhar se sairmos agora. Está chovendo agora.)

My husband and I are in contact with the orphanage. We’re talking with social worker. We’re looking for a child for adoption. (Meu marido e eu estamos em contato com o orfanato. Estamos conversando com a assistente social. Estamos procurando uma criança para adoção.)
I want to lose weight. I’m working on this. (Eu quero perder peso. Estou trabalhando nisso.)
